rules.sentence: With this arsenal of sonographic findings, a positive exam holds great clinical weight as does a negative exam with a fully visualized appendix.
Conversely, a radiologist can also readily determine when an ultrasound is indeterminate and recommend advanced imaging for definitive evaluation.
The general trend is that non-visualization of the appendix in the absence of secondary signs can be considered negative.
But this is certainly not unanimous with recent studies showing a lack of sensitivity based solely on the secondary signs in the setting of a non-visualized appendix.
